title: Outage Credit Day Count — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Cash Acceptances
content:
**Credit.** On the acceptance of a company-elected cash offer under a Homeowner Service Contract, the outage credit is 3.00 for each counted day, and the days are counted by the item and by how long the request had stood on the date of the accepted offer, because from that date the homeowner holds the cash that ends the outage. Accepting the cash closes the claim, so this credit, which Bridgewell owes on the request, is settled in the same payment: it is added to the accepted offer amount as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, before the total is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.

**Counted days.**

| Item | Request placed relative to the offer date | Days counted |
|---|---|---|
| heating system, water heater or refrigerator (the home is without heat, hot water or refrigeration) | at least 7 days before | every calendar day after the request date up to and including the offer date |
| any other item | at least 7 days before | only the days beyond the first 7 |
| any item | fewer than 7 days before | no day counts |

**Worked counts (hypothetical dates).**

| Item | Request date | Offer date | Days counted | Outage credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| refrigerator | May 1 | May 19 | 18 | 54.00 |
| cooling system | May 1 | May 19 | 18 less 7, so 11 | 33.00 |
| water heater | May 12 | May 19 | 7 | 21.00 |
| clothes washer | May 12 | May 19 | 7 less 7, so 0 | nothing |
| heating system | May 14 | May 19 | fewer than 7 days: none | nothing |

The offer date is the date of the company-elected offer that is accepted; the request date is the date the service request was placed.
